principal_decision: Proceed with one fixed exposure continuation after explicit calibrated-shadow bridge is exercised; retain prospectively written practical text-quality rubric and original numerical gates.
accepted: Continue existing continuous learning rather than infer capacity saturation or missing attention from weak prose.

rejected_or_scoped.proposal: Replace actual prose judgment with PacketD name/gender/nearest-entity/wordlist heuristics plus new greedy/midpoint panels.
rejected_or_scoped.reason: New characters and pronoun references can be valid; the heuristics do not measure event/role coherence. Would expand the campaign without fixing the stated semantic measurement need. Existing same-path samples and explicit rubric are retained.

rejected_or_scoped.proposal: Treat6-artifact source-score variation as binomial measurement noise and use+6rows as statistical evidence.
rejected_or_scoped.reason: Deterministic outputs from different fitted/quantized models are not repeated noisy measurements or independent binomial observations. Source panel remains retention, not language qualification.

rejected_or_scoped.proposal: Use exact_cache64 published scores as a same-parent standalone copy control.
rejected_or_scoped.reason: They come from a different trained candidate/access policy; not a matched independent control for this continuation.

rejected_or_scoped.proposal: Call repeated-token NLL/copy source slices referent or role correctness.
rejected_or_scoped.reason: Repeated BPE token identity is not entity/role semantics. Such slices could describe copying but do not replace actual coherence; no new analyzer is required to decide this milestone.

rejected_or_scoped.proposal: Expect80-85% of a projected0.14-0.19nat gain to survive export or assume3-10x trainer headroom.
rejected_or_scoped.reason: Extrapolations are unmeasured hypotheses; new-weight rounding can change, and arithmetic operation estimates do not establish achievable speed. Neither is an acceptance promise.

rejected_or_scoped.proposal: Flat token tape means story boundaries absent from objective.
rejected_or_scoped.reason: An EOS token can be represented in the token stream and next-token objective; lack of state reset is not proof that boundaries are unobserved.

rejected_or_scoped.proposal: A convex weighted read preserves distinct entities only when nearly one-hot; lack of explicit role channel means no role/order information.
rejected_or_scoped.reason: Distributed value components and recurrent state-conditioned keys/values can retain distinctions; actual representational sufficiency is empirical. These claims do not follow from the score/read formula.

independence_limit: Learning reviewer read its own and peer review logs; these are advisory source investigations, not independent experimental corroboration. Kimi is the CLI client name; requested model and launch receipts specify DeepSeek/deepseek-flash. Provider agreement is not validation.
